text.tspan: A room that plays, records and gives water
Relations within the Tank; spatial placements are schematic, not to scale.
Bands display spending; a boy is refused
Behind the third column; an intimate
A free glass buys the whole recorded night
Bought nights play through the week
The barman replaces tips with water for the
A > B: entry control / A > C: stairs behind column 3 / A > D: recording transaction / D > E: licensed to keep and show / D > F: the barman's action
The room's transactions coexist with a small act of care; neither the saucer nor the stairs is assigned an invented tariff.
